caseName: Balian Ice Cream Co. v. Arden Farms Co.
caseNameFull: Balian Ice Cream Co., Inc. v. Arden Farms Co.
attorneys: Gordon F. Hampton for petitioners. Julian O. von Kalinowski and Leonard A. Diether for respondents.

opinions.text: On petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit. The motion for leave to file brief of Dee C. Blythe and Lynell G. Skarda, as amici curiae, is denied. The petition for writ of certiorari is denied.
